Spikescale: Spike density in spikes per object-space unit. Higher = more, smaller spikes.
Height: Maximum spike height in object units, scaled by the field strength.
Sharp: Spike profile exponent. Higher = thinner, more concave spikes; low values give blunt humps.
Regular: 0 = irregular random spike layout, 1 = nearly regular lattice.
Baseline: Always-on magnetic field strength. 0 = flat liquid unless Modulation, the CHOP or the attractor raises it.
Modulation: Manual extra field strength added to Baseline. Use it for hand-animated spike growth.
Modgain: Multiplier for channel 0 of the in2 CHOP before it is added to the field strength.
Pull: Strength of the attractor's extra field. Spikes rise near the attractor, 0 disables it.
Reach: Falloff radius of the attractor in world units. Larger = affects more of the surface.
Lean: How much spikes tilt toward the attractor. 0 = straight along the normal.
Orbit: Radius in world units of the attractor's circular motion in the preview. 0 = attractor stays put.
Wobble: Per-spike height pulsing amount. Loops seamlessly with the preview cycle. 0 = static.
Variation: Static random height variation between spikes. 0 = all equal, 1 = strong differences.
Basecolor: Base colour of the fluid surface. Near black gives the classic ferrofluid look.
Reflectivity: Strength of the environment reflection. 0 = none, 1 = mirror.
Roughness: Surface roughness. Near 0 = sharp mirror reflections, higher = blurrier.
Speed: Speed multiplier of the time-based animation (wobble, orbit, preview spin).
Envmix: Blend between the built-in studio environment (0) and the in1 equirect map (1).
Envrot: Rotates the environment around the vertical axis, 0 to 1 = one full turn.
Envgain: Brightness multiplier of the reflected environment.
Accent: Strength of the red accent light bar in the built-in environment. 0 = off.
Attractor: World-space position of the attractor that pulls spikes. The preview adds the Orbit motion on top of it.
Resolution: Output size in pixels of the internal preview render.
Geometry: Preview shapes: both shows sphere and torus knot, sphere or knot shows just one.
Spin: Number of full turns the preview objects make per animation cycle. 0 = static.
Camdist: Distance of the preview camera in world units.
Backdrop: Brightness of the preview background. 0 = black.
Exposure: Exposure multiplier of the preview render before tonemapping.
Vignette: Darkening toward the preview edges. 0 = none, higher = stronger.
